title: XPI per-run coverage ledger
description: Deterministic record of what one audit run did and did not examine. Complements Casefile CoverageAdd/CoverageReport (tested asset x attack-class view): the ledger is the per-run authority for review units and their evidence. A unit closed as covered/not_applicable must list reviewed paths and evidence-backed checks — an agent returning no finding is never coverage. Validated by scripts/validate-records.js.

id.description: Stable ID derived from source/surface, trust boundary, subsystem, and attack class where relevant, e.g. 'src/api/upload.ts:unauth:file-upload'.

reviewedPaths.description: Repo-relative source paths actually read. Required to close a unit as covered or not_applicable.

checks.description: Evidence-backed checks performed for this unit.

ref.description: Case ID, evidence item ID, artifact path, or recorded tool call reference.

findings.description: Finding fingerprints produced or ruled out by this unit.

reason.description: Why the unit is blocked/deferred/out_of_scope/not_applicable — required for those statuses.

revisitWhen.description: Concrete trigger for deferred units (new endpoint, new creds, new CVE).

sourceRevision.description: Revision the unit was last validated against; changed source invalidates the unit.
